create_S3BinaryPath: create an S3BinaryPath from a repo path, BinaryInfo, and version string
create_LocalBinaryPath: create a LocalBinaryPath from an executable folder path and BinaryInfo
create_BinaryInfo: create a BinaryInfo dataclass with a package name and optional binary name
stringify_S3BinaryPath: stringify an S3BinaryPath instance to get its full S3 path as a string
stringify_LocalBinaryPath: stringify a LocalBinaryPath instance to get its full local file path as a string
